about_the_game:
Unleash your wrath in the name of Sanguinius with the Blood Angels Cosmetic Pack!

This DLC contains more than 40 cosmetic items and options including chapter heraldry for the left and right pauldrons, decals, unique helmets, knee markings, and colour packs from 8 Blood Angels Successor Chapters:

Atlantian Spears

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Temple Guard Blue Colour Pack

- Valdor Gold Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron 6th Company marking

- Right Greave 3rd Squad marking

- Left Greave 5th Squad marking

Blood Dragons

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Blood Angels Red Colour Pack

- Right Greave 5th Squad marking

- Right Greave 7th Squad marking

- Bionic Eye Mk X Helmet

Flesh Eaters

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Full Stripe Helm Pattern

- Wazdakka Red Colour Pack

- Right Greave 9th Squad marking

- Left Greave 7th Squad marking

Blood Scythes

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Black Templar Tertiary Colour

- Right Greave Chapter marking

- Left Greave 3rd Squad marking

- Baal’s Armour Right Pauldron

Lamenters

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Flash Gitz Yellow Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron Death Company marking

- Right Pauldron Lieutenant marking

- Baal’s Armour Breastplate

Angels Penitent

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Penitent Armour Pattern

- Thondia Brown Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron 10th Company marking

- Left Greave 1st Squad marking

Angels Sanguine

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Baal Red Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron 2nd Company marking

- Right Greave 1st Squad marking

- Left Greave Chapter marking

- Left Greave 9th Squad marking

Flesh Tearers

- Left Pauldron Chapter Heraldry

- Flesh Tearers Red Colour Pack

- Right Pauldron Close Support Chapter marking

- Right Pauldron Battleline Chapter marking

- Blood Angels Bionic Eye Mk X Helmet

The Blood Angels Cosmetic Pack is available as part of the Season Pass.

content_descriptors.notes:
Gameplay consists of frequent combat scenarios with characters using their weapons to slash/stab enemies.

Strong Language is used in the dialogue.
